R1.kind: offline inspection and exposure registry for catalyst v1

known_reads.name: broad-universe reserved segment evaluation
known_reads.source: blueprints/us-equities/broad-universe/protocol.json; README.md (reserved segment and its single evaluation)

known_reads.name: inspected 2021Q1 ETF control and the LEAN/AAPL2020, FB/META2022 samples

R1.conservative_rule: A universe-wide read over a date range marks every case of that universe in that range inspected.

hypotheses.H1.1: Every known_reads item has at least one entry; misses found after the freeze become dated deviations.
hypotheses.H1.2: contract.reserved_access refuses every case covered by an inspected entry in synthetic tests (>=1 per entry kind) and admits a synthetic uninspected case with a valid hash.
hypotheses.H1.3: catalyst-experiment/protocol.json and contract.py are byte-identical to base_commit.
hypotheses.D1: A v1 session whose eligible universe is covered by an inspected entry is ineligible for reserved evaluation, with no substitute dates; eligible session counts are reported per segment; no performance claim.

receipts: summary: entries by kind, eligible sessions per segment

R2a.kind: offline replay of E2 on NativeStack2604
R2a.input_run: research/asof-20260929 under the private state root, copied from NativeStack into a fresh 0700 directory
R2a.procedure: Each arm on its own fresh copy without results.json, labels.json, summary.json and verify.json: refetch.py classify --out-dir <copy>/e2, then classify --out-dir <copy>/e2 --verify. No network, no credential, nice 19, TMPDIR outside /tmp.
R2a.interpreter: Python 3.12.3 with numpy 2.5.3 (mover-early-entry/README.md:44), 2604 research runtime project

hypotheses.H2.1: Arm A reproduces results.json and labels.json byte for byte and its verify passes.
hypotheses.H2.2: Both arms give the expected totals.
hypotheses.H2.3: Arm B's output hashes are reported; a difference from Arm A is a code-revision effect, described field by field, not a replay failure.

R2a.fail_rule: An input-hash mismatch or an Arm A mismatch is a FAIL retained as is; no retry with changed inputs.

R2b.starts_after: R1 registers E2's events as inspected and adds this profile as an inspection (purpose: descriptive profile)
R2b.claim_rule: Description only; gainers-only, outcome-selected set with no negatives: any recall, precision or predictive claim is insufficient_evidence (catalyst-experiment protocol.json promotion.extreme_label_claim).
R2b.use_rule: May inform hypothesis generation for a later catalyst design (development only); never selects thresholds for an evaluation segment.
receipts: totals-only bucket counts through the existing schema scan; per-event tables private
